strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: léa ŋku ɖe keybox si li fifia ŋu le Google ƒe revocation list (CRL) nu eye wòtea dzɔtsoƒe geɖewo kpɔ vaseɖe esime wòkpɔ keybox si sɔ, kple automatic backup kple Google subɔsubɔdɔwo gbugbɔgadzedze. Ewɔa dɔ le pɔmpi ɖesiaɖe dzi eye wòhiã internet (aɖabaƒoƒo 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox tso network: eɖea keybox tso official repository (GitHub) me eye wòdzranɛ ɖo ɖe /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Ehiã internet eye wòxɔa miniti 1-3. Wozãnɛ ne smart fetch la do kpo nu alo ne wotsɔ asi trɔ safuiɖaka la.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: léa ŋku ɖe Remote Key Provisioning modules siwo li ŋu, léa ŋku ɖe TEE ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽ ƒe tɔtrɔ ŋu, eye wòɖea KmInstallKeybox dɔwɔnu ƒe nɔnɔme fiana. Metrɔa naneke o — mɔ̃a ƒe nɔnɔme kpɔkpɔ dzro aɖe.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (xexlẽ ɖeɖeko): ɖea Widevine dzidzenu ƒe dzesiwo (L1/L3) tso dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file ƒe anyinɔnɔ, kple ɖoɖo ƒe nɔnɔme siwo do ƒome kplii me. Metrɔa asi le naneke ŋu kura o.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP ɖɔɖɔɖo: ƒua du sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh mɔfiamegbalẽ. Eɖɔa ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe nyawo ɖo ne automatic pass la do kpo nu. Duƒuƒu ɖesiaɖe taa dzidzedze/kpododonu ƒe fli si me kɔ.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Gbugbɔ ɖo GMS: kɔ Play Store kple Google subɔsubɔdɔwo (GMS+GSF) ƒe nyatakakawo eye wògbugbɔa mɔ̃a dzea egɔme le eɖokui si. Le ɖaseɖiɖi sesẽ ɖeɖeko ta — meka asi wò fotowo alo faɛlwo ŋu gbeɖe o.
strings.mdCertify: • Ƒo ɖaseɖigbalẽ: léa ŋku ɖe RKP ɖaseɖigbalẽ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe nɔnɔme si le mɔ̃a ŋu eye wògbugbɔ ɖoa ​​ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe nɔnɔmewo ne ehiã. Meka asi zãla ƒe nyatakakawo ŋu o.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER dzadzraɖo: ɖɔ Google subɔsubɔdɔwo ƒe ɖoɖo (SOTER) ƒe nya siwo ku ɖe mɔ̃a ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ŋu ɖo. Wozãnɛ na mɔ̃ aɖewo siwo ɖoa ŋu ɖe SOTER ŋu ɖe Play Integrity teƒe.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: fia mɔ̃a ƒe nɔnɔme si woda ɖe eme, asibidɛ ƒe faɛlwo (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kple nuŋlɔɖiwo. Check only — metrɔa naneke o.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary ƒe yeyewɔwɔ: ƒua du sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Exɔa Canary Engine ƒe tata yeyetɔ be wòakpɔ egbɔ be ewɔ ɖeka kple RKP ɖaseɖigbalẽ siwo wobia tso esi (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: léa ŋku ɖe TrickyStoreOSS nɔnɔme (pid, logs), safuiɖaka ƒe faɛlwo (active vs user), nyateƒe vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP safuiwo. Diagnostic ɖeɖefia ɖeɖeko.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module la kpɔa keybox ƒe teƒe eve dzi: gbãtɔ (kɔkɔe, wometutui gbeɖe o) kple evelia (backup). Tab sia fiaa slot si le dɔ wɔm, trɔa nusi nèdi, alo doa evelia ɖe ŋgɔ yi gbãtɔ dzi le biabia si dze ƒã me — kple backups kple log blibo.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: léa ŋku ɖe TEE safui ƒe tsɔtsɔ yi teƒe bubu, agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ƒe injection le keystore2 me, revocation nɔnɔme (CRL), protection-list coverage kple RKP nɔnɔme. Nuxexlẽ ɖeɖeko — metrɔa naneke o.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Wogbugbɔa ametakpɔkpɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesi la tu tso app ɖesiaɖe si woda ɖe eme la me.
• Wogawɔ custom-ROM compatibility layer la ŋudɔ.
• Wogawɔ keybox si le dɔ wɔm la ŋudɔ.
• Google Play subɔsubɔdɔwo gbugbɔ dze egɔme.

Naneke meli o woɖee ɖa eye womeka asi safuiɖaka gbãtɔ ŋu gbeɖe o.

Yi edzi?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: fiaa nɔnɔme si me gbãtɔ kple evelia ƒe slots le eye wòtrɔa nusi nèdi le wo dome. Wokpɔa gbãtɔ (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ta ɣesiaɣi eye wometutunɛ gbeɖe o. Evelia dodo ɖe ŋgɔ na gbãtɔ bia be woaɖo kpe edzi tẽ.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Do evelia ƒe slot ɖe ŋgɔ na primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml va zua gbãtɔ slot me nyawo.
• Wodzra primary si li fifia ɖo abe backup ene hafi woaɖɔlii.
• Wometutu naneke o — dɔwɔwɔa nye tɔtrɔ.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Klɔ evelia ƒe ʋɔtrua:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml woaɖe ɖa.
• Womeka asi gbãtɔ ƒe ʋɔtrua ŋu o.

Yi edzi?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (yeye le v3.17):

• Kpɔ safuiɖaka si li fifia ɖe Google revocation list (CRL) ŋu.
• Te dzɔtsoƒe geɖewo kpɔ vaseɖe esime wokpɔ keybox dzadzɛ.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet dzi (aɖabaƒoƒo 1-3). Yi edzi?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox from the internet:

• Ewɔa keybox si dziɖuɖua ɖo la ƒe kɔpi eye wòda asi ɖe edzi.
• Wodae ɖe eme tegbee (wometrɔe gbeɖe le gɔmedzedzea me o).

⚠️ Ehiã internet (vaseɖe miniti 1). Yi edzi?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Gbugbɔ na RKP safuiwo:

• Wometutu nyatakaka alo safuiɖaka ƒe faɛl aɖeke ɖa o.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Dzadzraɖo blibo:

• Gbugbɔ ɖoɖo RKP + gbugbɔ dze Google subɔsubɔdɔwo gɔme.
• Mɔ̃a gbugbɔ dze dɔ gɔme le eɖokui si (wometutu naneke o).

strings.confirmGmsReset:
Gbugbɔ dze Google subɔsubɔdɔwo gɔme:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — gbugbɔ dze egɔme ko.
• Wometutu naneke o eye MELE asi le asiwò o.
• Mɔ̃a gbugbɔ dze dɔ gɔme le eɖokui si.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Na mɔ̃ siwo ŋea aɖaba ƒua safuiɖaka si do go dzi.
• Ewɔa dɔ ne safuiawo le lãmesẽ me gɔ̃ hã.
• Wometutu nyatakaka aɖeke ɖa o.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Klɔ Fiase ƒe cache ɖeɖeko — wò akɔnta mekpɔ asi o.
• Gbugbɔ dze egɔme, emegbe nàʋu Fiasea.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER dzadzraɖo:

• Gbugbɔ dze vendor.soter subɔsubɔdɔa gɔme.
• Klɔ SOTER dɔdzikpɔla ƒe nyatakakawo ɖeɖeko.

Yi edzi?
strings.confirmPifApply:
De asibidɛ ƒe dzesi (PIF):

• Trɔ custom.pif.prop eye wòdee mɔ̃a ƒe mɔ me.
